metadata.title: Government Agricultural Schemes (India)
metadata.verification_note: Details are compiled from official Government of India scheme portals. Fields marked "needs_verification" could not be confirmed from a primary source at the time of writing and MUST be checked on the official portal or at a bank / Common Service Centre / agriculture office before acting. No eligibility condition, subsidy amount, or deadline is stated here unless it came from an official source.
metadata.disclaimer: This is reference information, not an endorsement or an application. Scheme rules and amounts change; always confirm current details on the official portal linked for each scheme.

legend.confirmed: Stated on the official government portal at last verification.
legend.needs_verification: General description only — specifics (eligibility, amounts, dates) were not confirmed from a primary source.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.summary: Direct income support paid to eligible landholding farmer families, credited as instalments directly to the bank account.

purpose.text: Provide direct income support to eligible landholding farmer families, paid in instalments directly to the bank account.

eligibility.text: Eligible landholding farmer families as defined by the scheme. Registration and Aadhaar-linked bank account details are required.
eligibility.note: The exact eligibility definition and any exclusions can change — confirm on the official PM-KISAN portal.

benefits.text: Income support paid in instalments directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
The current instalment amount is not stated here because it is revised from time to time — confirm the latest figure on the official portal.

application_process.step: Check current eligibility on the official PM-KISAN portal.
Register with Aadhaar and bank account details (self-service on the portal or via a Common Service Centre / agriculture office).
Await verification and instalment credit to the linked bank account.

schemes.name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
schemes.summary: Crop insurance against losses from natural calamities, pests and diseases, with the government subsidising most of the premium.

purpose.text: Insure farmers against crop losses from natural calamities, pests and diseases.

eligibility.text: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas during a notified season. Enrolment is usually through banks, cooperatives, or the national crop insurance portal.
eligibility.note: Notified crops and areas differ by state and season — confirm with your bank or the official portal.

benefits.text: Farmers pay a modest share of the premium; the government subsidises the remaining premium.
The exact premium share and sum-insured rules are set per season and are not stated here — confirm on the official portal.

application_process.step: Enrol through your bank, cooperative, or the national crop insurance portal within the notified cut-off date for the season.
Pay the farmer's share of the premium at enrolment.
If a crop loss occurs, report it promptly to the insurer / bank to raise a claim.

official_links.label: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana official portal

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.summary: Soil-test-based information on nutrient status with crop-wise fertiliser recommendations, to improve fertiliser use efficiency.

purpose.text: Give farmers soil-test-based information on nutrient status and crop-wise fertiliser recommendations, to improve fertiliser use efficiency and reduce unnecessary spending.

eligibility.text: Farmers whose soil samples are collected and tested under the scheme. Samples are collected and tested, and a card is issued with recommendations.
eligibility.note: How and when samples are collected varies by state — check with your local agriculture department.

benefits.text: A Soil Health Card giving nutrient status and crop-wise fertiliser recommendations.
Helps improve fertiliser use efficiency and reduce unnecessary spending.

application_process.step: Contact your local agriculture department / Krishi Vigyan Kendra to have soil samples collected and tested.
Receive the Soil Health Card with nutrient status and recommendations.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.summary: Timely access to short-term credit for crop inputs and other needs, at concessional interest with prompt-repayment incentives.

purpose.text: Provide farmers with timely access to short-term credit for crop inputs and other needs, at concessional interest with prompt-repayment incentives.

eligibility.text: Available through banks; may also cover animal husbandry and fisheries needs in many cases.
eligibility.note: Eligibility and documentation are decided by the issuing bank — confirm at your bank branch.

benefits.text: Short-term credit for crop inputs and related needs at concessional interest with prompt-repayment incentives.
The current interest rate and credit limit are not stated here — confirm with your bank.

application_process.step: Apply at a bank that issues Kisan Credit Cards.
Submit identity, land records, and bank account documents as required by the bank.

schemes.verification_note: Administered through banks; no single self-service application URL. Contact your bank branch.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
schemes.summary: Expands irrigation coverage ("Har Khet Ko Pani") and improves water-use efficiency ("Per Drop More Crop"), supporting micro-irrigation.

purpose.text: Expand irrigation coverage ("Har Khet Ko Pani") and improve water-use efficiency ("Per Drop More Crop").

eligibility.text: Supports micro-irrigation (drip and sprinkler). Applications are handled by the state agriculture / horticulture department.
eligibility.note: State-level norms and subsidy percentages vary — confirm with your state agriculture / horticulture department.

benefits.text: Support for micro-irrigation (drip and sprinkler) with subsidies.
Subsidy amounts are set per state and are not stated here — confirm with your state department.

application_process.step: Apply through your state agriculture / horticulture department.

schemes.verification_note: State-administered; no single central self-service application URL. Contact your state agriculture / horticulture department.

schemes.name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
schemes.summary: An online trading platform linking mandis to help farmers get better price discovery and access to more buyers.

purpose.text: Link mandis on an online trading platform to help farmers get better price discovery and reach more buyers.

eligibility.text: Farmers can sell produce through participating mandis and registered traders.
eligibility.note: Participation depends on whether your local mandi is integrated — confirm locally.

benefits.text: Online access to participating mandis and registered traders for better price discovery.

application_process.step: Sell produce through a participating mandi with registered traders.

schemes.verification_note: Access is through participating mandis; ask at your local mandi about e-NAM integration.

additional_support.name: Agricultural extension and Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs)
additional_support.summary: Free or low-cost technical advice, demonstrations, and training.

additional_support.name: Kisan Call Centre
additional_support.summary: Telephone advisory service for farming queries.

additional_support.name: State-specific schemes
additional_support.summary: Many states run additional subsidy and support programmes — check your state agriculture department.

cautions: Be cautious of anyone charging money to "guarantee" a scheme benefit.
Keep copies of applications and receipts.
Apply within notified timelines — especially for crop insurance.
